lcc_original: 過了許多日子，該隱帶了地裏的果實爲供物【2】獻給永恆主。
notes: Temporal phrase split: UNV '有<WAH01961><WTH8799>' → LCC '過了' (verbal element, H1961 Qal impf); UNV '一日<WAH04480><WH07093><WH03117>' → LCC '許多日子' (the מִקֵּץ יָמִים complex). LCC renders the phrase more expansively ('after many days') than UNV ('one day'), but the Hebrew is the same.
UNV '耶和華' → LCC '永恆主': both map to H3068.
LCC footnote marker 【2】 preserved in situ after 供物; SN tag placed after the entire token including the marker.
UNV '拿' (H935, Hiphil 'to bring') → LCC '帶了': straightforward verbal correspondence.
UNV '出產' → LCC '果實': both render H6529 (פְּרִי, fruit/produce of the ground).
